expectation.note: No wall time is skipped or repeated; an engine that keys gap/fold detection on the isdst flag reports a transition here and mis-resolves the instant.

normative_evidence.note: Jordan and Syria made +03 permanent in October 2022; the transition changes the abbreviation and the isdst flag but not the offset

rationale: The zero-offset transition separates two implementation strategies that are otherwise indistinguishable: comparing utcoffset() (correct) versus comparing dst() or the abbreviation (incorrect).
title: Zero-offset transition: Asia/Amman abolishes DST (2022)
